scenes.title: Key ideas
scenes.vo: Scale Module 1's three wallets into a bank-grade setup: Smart-account features to use where available: Vault, Most of your equity, Multisig, for example 2-of-3 hardware keys in separate locations, No DeFi approvals. scenes.title: Worked example
steps: Losing any one key is survivable; stealing any one key is useless.
scenes.vo: Let's work an example, step by step. Vault: 2-of-3 multisig, with key A at home, key B in a safe-deposit box and key C with a trusted person or a professional co-signer. Losing any one key is survivable; stealing any one key is useless. Test it: move $10 through every path once a quarter.

scenes.title: Checklist
items: Vault is multisig; keys in separate physical locations
Operating tier has a daily limit
Quarterly recovery test done and logged
scenes.vo: Here's your checklist. Do it now, for real. First, Vault is multisig; keys in separate physical locations. Next, Operating tier has a daily limit. Then, Allowlist on vault outflows. And finally, Quarterly recovery test done and logged.
